direction.name: OFFLINE STUDY: Sea Grape Estate
direction.concept: A contemporary Caribbean estate of differentiated pavilions: a double-height glass living pavilion at the centre, a stone entry gallery, a master wing with a cantilevered upper suite and low pitched guest and service wings.
direction.roofLanguage: Flat planes over the pavilion and master suite; gently pitched bronze roofs on the low wings.
direction.entrance: A stone entry gallery set forward on the arrival court.
direction.outdoorLiving: A deep covered veranda and a long lap pool.
direction.landscape: Palms, layered beds and open lawn.

vision.compositionIntent: A central glass pavilion with an entry gallery to the north and wings of distinct heights to east and west.

signatureFeatures.intent: Floor-to-ceiling glass on both long sides.
The pavilion is the tallest mass.
The master suite projects beyond its base.
A deep veranda off the pavilion.

blocks.role: Master wing: study, gym and stair

openSpaces.role: Deep covered veranda off the pavilion
Pool reservation for a lap pool south of the master wing

pool.intentResolution: Stage 5 resolves conceptual reservation lap-pool (18×8.4 m at 19.5, 11.2) as one lap 14×4 m pool whose full deck envelope is 17.2×8.4 m, centred at 19.5, 12.4; promenade separation clears the accepted house front.

design.statement: OFFLINE STUDY: a lap pool terrace and palms.
